name: dsh-plugins-plus
description: SparkElf-maintained independent plugins for DeepSeek Harness (dsh), installable through profile bundles and reusable published capability packages.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @sparkelf/dsh-mobile-bridge build && pnpm --filter @sparkelf/dsh-dataops-integration build && pnpm --filter @sparkelf/dsh-dataops-managed build && pnpm --filter @sparkelf/dsh-chart build && pnpm --filter @sparkelf/dsh-query-result-analysis build && pnpm --filter @sparkelf/dsh-workbench-vault build && pnpm --filter @sparkelf/dsh-ssh-manager build && pnpm --filter @sparkelf/dsh-api-client build && pnpm --filter @sparkelf/dsh-mineru build && pnpm --filter @sparkelf/dsh-officecli build && pnpm --filter @sparkelf/dsh-office-viewer-fonts build && pnpm --dir packages/supervisor run build
scripts.test: vitest run packages && pnpm --dir packages/supervisor run test
